attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Nursing (Office of Professional Regulation, Secretary of State)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Qualifying CE approved and assigned credit by an ANCC-accredited organization, another Board-approved verifying authority, or the Board itself
rules.alternatives: CE is one of several options: instead, attest to 50 days (400 hours) of paid nursing practice in the last 2 years or 120 days (960 hours) in the last 5 years, hold a nationally recognized nursing certification, or have completed an initial or re-entry nursing program within the last 5 years.
rules.new_licensee_rule: A license first issued within 90 days of the end of a licensing period is issued through the next full period without renewal or fee.
rules.legal_basis: Administrative Rules of the Vermont Board of Nursing, Rule 4-8 (effective May 11, 2023)
rules.notes: Licenses run for fixed two-year periods; the expiry date is printed on the license (not stated in the rules). Renewal opens six weeks before expiry in OPR Online Services; CE certificates are uploaded with the application if the CE option is used.
